bib.title: UI-TARS: Pioneering Automated GUI Interaction with Native Agents

read.skipped: References skimmed; Fig 8 values are in a figure image, not text.

question: Can a single end-to-end vision-language model that sees only screenshots and outputs keyboard/mouse actions beat prompted commercial-model agent frameworks on GUI perception, grounding and task execution?
hypothesis: A native agent model trained on large GUI data with system-2 reasoning and iterative reflective online traces outperforms modular agent frameworks built on GPT-4o or Claude.
contributions: Enhanced perception for GUI screenshots from a large-scale screenshot dataset with five task types
Unified action modeling across platforms with large-scale action traces and grounding data
System-2 reasoning: thoughts before each action, built from ~6M GUI tutorials and thought augmentation
Iterative refinement with reflective online traces: online bootstrapping on hundreds of virtual machines, reflection tuning and DPO
A review of the evolution path of GUI agents and an analysis of core capabilities

method.summary: Qwen-2-VL 2B/7B/72B are continually trained on about 50B tokens of GUI perception, grounding, action-trace and reasoning data in three phases (continual pre-training, annealing giving UI-TARS-SFT, DPO on reflective pairs from online bootstrapping giving UI-TARS-DPO). The agent takes screenshots, the last N=5 observations plus full thought/action history, and emits a thought then an action from a unified action space.
method.task: GUI agent: perception, grounding and multi-step task execution from screenshots

datasets.name: Screenshot perception data (element description, dense captioning, state transition captioning, QA, set-of-mark)
datasets.source: Own crawled and human-assisted collection of screenshots with parsed metadata (element type, depth, bounding box, text) from websites, apps and operating systems; descriptions synthesized by a VLM
datasets.preprocessing: Bottom-up construction from elements to whole interface

datasets.name: Grounding data, open source (Web / Mobile / Desktop)
datasets.source: SeeClick, GUIAct, MultiUI, Rico-SCA, WidgetCaption, MUG, Rico Icon, CLAY, UIBERT, OmniACT, AutoGUI, OS-ATLAS
datasets.preprocessing: Bounding-box centre taken as point; coordinates normalized to screen size; standardized to unified action format

datasets.name: Multi-step action traces, open source
datasets.size: Web 6.4k traces (7.1 avg steps), Mobile 145k (9.6), Desktop 0
datasets.source: MM-Mind2Web, GUIAct, AITW, AITZ, AndroidControl, GUI-Odyssey, AMEX

datasets.name: Multi-step action traces, own annotated
datasets.size: avg steps 14.9 per trace; trace count not stated (Table 2 shows '*'); own grounding avg 7.5 ele./image
datasets.source: Annotation tool over PC software and websites; instructions reviewed by annotators; quality filtering
datasets.preprocessing: Thoughts added via ActRe and thought bootstrapping; Chinese and English; vanilla traces without thought also used

datasets.name: GUI tutorials
datasets.size: ~6M tutorials, avg 510 text tokens and 3.3 images
datasets.preprocessing: fastText classifier, LLM filtering iterated, URL and LSH dedup, LLM rephrase

datasets.name: Online bootstrapped traces and reflection pairs
datasets.source: Model rollouts on hundreds of virtual PCs, filtered by rule-based reward, VLM scoring (threshold unstated) and human review; annotators label error corrections and post-reflection steps
datasets.preprocessing: Positive samples used for SFT with loss only on corrected steps; (corrected, erroneous) pairs used for DPO

datasets.name: ScreenSpot-Pro, ScreenSpot, ScreenSpot-V2
datasets.source: Public benchmarks; ScreenSpot-Pro covers 23 applications in five industries and three operating systems

datasets.name: Multimodal Mind2Web, AndroidControl, GUI Odyssey
datasets.size: 1,000 randomly sampled examples each for AndroidControl and GUI Odyssey in the section 5.5 system-1/2 ablation
datasets.source: Public benchmarks; also in training data (in-domain)

datasets.name: OSWorld, AndroidWorld
datasets.size: OSWorld 369 tasks (Ubuntu, Windows, macOS); AndroidWorld 116 tasks across 20 apps
datasets.source: Public online environments; AndroidWorld has no training data in UI-TARS (out-of-domain)

models.name: UI-TARS-2B / 7B / 72B
models.context: inferred: 32k sequence length mentioned as typical constrained token budget

other.history_window_N: 5 last observations (Eq. 3), full thought/action history retained

models.name: GPT-4o, Claude-3.5-Sonnet / Claude Computer Use, Gemini-1.5-Pro, Gemini-2.0 (Project Mariner), CogAgent, OmniParser, InternVL, Aria-UI, Aguvis, OS-Atlas, UGround, ShowUI, SeeClick, Qwen-VL, Qwen2-VL, UIX-Qwen2-7B, Qwen-VL-Max

training.objective: SFT (next-token on thoughts and actions, plus perception and grounding tasks) then DPO: L_DPO = -E log sigma(beta log(pi_theta(a'|s)/pi_SFT(a'|s)) - beta log(pi_theta(a|s)/pi_SFT(a|s))) over error-correction pairs
training.lr: constant during continual pre-training (value not stated)
training.lr_schedule: constant in phase 1; annealing in phase 2
training.seq_len: inferred: 32k mentioned as typical token budget

other.phase_1: Continual pre-training on all data except reflection tuning data, constant learning rate
other.phase_2: Annealing on high-quality subsets of perception, grounding, action trace and reflection tuning data; result is UI-TARS-SFT
other.phase_3: DPO on annotated reflective pairs from online bootstrapping; result is UI-TARS-DPO
other.reflection_tuning_loss: SFT loss only on corrected steps (t*_tau,a*_tau) and (t*_tau+1,a*_tau+1), not on error steps
other.online_bootstrapping: Iterated on hundreds of virtual PCs for multiple rounds; M_{n+1}=FineTune(M_n,T_filtered,n); rounds count unstated

inference.samples: Section 5.5: Best-of-N with N = 1, 16, 64 (step success rate); out-of-domain AndroidWorld at Bo1. OSWorld score averaged over 3 runs.
inference.prompting: System-1 vs system-2 chosen at inference by prompt engineering (prompt text not given). Input: instruction, history of last N=5 observations plus all prior thoughts/actions, current screenshot. Output: thought then action.

parameters.action_space: Click, Drag, Scroll, Type, Wait, Finished, CallUser (shared); Hotkey, LeftDouble, RightSingle (desktop); LongPress, PressBack, PressHome, PressEnter (mobile)

other.osworld_scoring: Runs where the model decides CallUser or fails to output Finish are counted as infeasible; screenshot-only mode

limits: No hyperparameters (learning rate, batch size, optimizer, DPO beta, hardware, compute) are given, so the training is not reproducible from the paper.
Own annotated trace count, perception data size and online-bootstrap rounds are not stated.
Only OSWorld uses UI-TARS-DPO; other benchmarks use the SFT model.
System-2 reasoning is worse than system-1 at a single sample in-domain; authors name reinforced fine-tuning as future work.
ScreenSpot v1/v2 do not separate 7B from 72B; the authors suggest those benchmarks are not robust at higher scale.
Offline benchmarks may not reflect online capability (72B vs 7B gap is larger online).
Baseline figures appear copied from other papers; protocol parity is not discussed. Benchmarks AndroidControl, Mind2Web and GUI Odyssey are in the training mix, so they are in-domain.
Dated: OSWorld numbers are from Jan 2025; later releases (UI-TARS-1.5/2) supersede them.

terms.definition: Workflow knowledge is embedded directly within the agent's model, with perception, reasoning, memory and action unified in a single end-to-end model rather than a framework of prompted modules.
Deliberate, structured, analytical thinking that explicitly generates intermediate thoughts (task decomposition, long-term consistency, milestone recognition, trial and error, reflection).
Training on the model's own online errors with annotator-labelled corrections and post-reflection steps, SFT on corrected steps only.
